name: task-budget
description: Know what a task will cost before Claude starts. The mod gives a likely cost with odds from your own past chats, advises a cheaper model or effort level when the task fits one, counts the real cost live, and pauses the chat before a dollar limit is passed. It learns from every task. Past chats are read on this machine, after you say yes; an estimate sends the model up to 5 short pieces of matching past prompts.

forceHelperModel.title: Subagents on Sonnet or Haiku
forceHelperModel.description: On: every subagent in every chat runs on Sonnet or Haiku, never Opus or Fable, at medium effort at most. Off: only the subagents of a /budget task are capped.
